title: _Nonnull annotation contradicts documented NULL behavior in tx_queue_count
description:
Line 191 documents '-EINVAL if queue is NULL' but line 192 declares the parameter as _Nonnull. Same class of bug as tx_queue_empty - the annotation and documentation express contradictory contracts.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/tx_queue.h
Line: 192
close_reason: Fixed: changed _Nonnull to _Nullable on tx_queue_count parameter to match documented NULL handling behavior (returns -EINVAL if NULL)
